description: White ivory going tan at the root, worn fine by use. Cave-jaws and dusk-hunters both leave these behind.
lore: Six animals leave this exact tooth and on a counter there is no telling which: [[monsters/crystal_lynx|Prismclaw]], [[monsters/ice_wolf|Winterfang]], [[monsters/saber_toothed_tiger|Duskfang]], and three more, and anybody who works that country will give you the other three differently.

Twelve gold, which is what a curved fang is worth when it could be anything. One that somebody watched come out fetches four times that, and the difference is not ivory, it is the watching. [[characters/7a779de1|Wendell]] put it best with one in his hand at a fire, in the middle of trading what he remembers of the east road for the company of people willing to hear it again: you are not buying the tooth, you are buying somebody who was there. Then he sold them the east road one more time, and they paid him in the same coin, and everyone got what they came for.
gm_notes: The thesis of junk stated by the man who lives off it: the object is worthless, the witness is the goods. Wendell's whole trade in one transaction.
